description: Project scaffolding, database schema, and core infrastructure. Sets up the Next.js project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma with PostgreSQL, Docker Compose for local dev, and the foundational data model covering parties, menu items, requests, and locations.
steps: Create a new Next.js 14 project with App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS in the workspace root. Initialize package.json with project name 'partyswoop'.
Install core dependencies: prisma, @prisma/client, nanoid (for unguessable codes), qrcode and @types/qrcode (QR generation), next, react, react-dom, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer.

Create prisma/schema.prisma with PostgreSQL provider and these models: Party (id, name, guestCode, hostCode, createdAt, expiresAt), MenuItem (id, partyId, name, available, category enum DRINK/SUPPLY, createdAt), Location (id, partyId, name, code), Request (id, partyId, category enum DRINK/SUPPLY/SONG/OTHER, item, note, deliveryType enum LOCATION/NAME, deliveryValue, status enum NEW/SEEN/DONE, locationId nullable, createdAt). Use nanoid for guestCode and hostCode (8 chars, no ambiguous characters: exclude 0OIl1). Party has 24h expiry calculated from createdAt.
Create src/lib/db.ts - singleton Prisma client instance (standard Next.js pattern to avoid multiple instances in dev).

Create src/lib/codes.ts - utility to generate unguessable codes using nanoid with custom alphabet excluding visually ambiguous characters (0, O, I, l, 1). Provide generatePartyCode(length=8) and generateLocationCode(length=6).

Create src/lib/sse.ts - Server-Sent Events manager. In-memory event bus using EventEmitter pattern. Provides: subscribe(partyId, callback), publish(partyId, eventType, data). Events: 'menu-update', 'request-update', 'new-request'. This enables the 3-second propagation requirement.
Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL 16 service (port 5432, partyswoop db, user/password for dev) and the app service building from Dockerfile.
Create Dockerfile - multi-stage build: (1) deps stage installs node_modules, (2) builder stage runs prisma generate and next build, (3) runner stage with standalone Next.js output. Expose port 3000.
Create next.config.js with output: 'standalone' for Docker deployment.
Create tailwind.config.ts configured for src/ directory content paths.
Create src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives and any base styles.
Create src/app/layout.tsx as root layout with metadata (title: PartySwoop), global styles import, and responsive viewport meta.
Create src/app/page.tsx as a simple landing/create party page placeholder.
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode and path aliases (@/ -> src/).
Run npx prisma generate to verify the schema compiles. Run npm run build to verify the project compiles.
acceptance_criteria: npx prisma generate succeeds and creates the Prisma client
npm run build completes successfully producing .next/standalone output
docker build completes successfully (may not connect to DB but image builds)
All TypeScript files compile without errors
The Prisma schema correctly models all entities per the requirements
verification: Run npm install && npx prisma generate && npm run build
Run docker build -t partyswoop:test . to confirm Docker image builds
